title: 2.2 Characteristics of Quadratic Functions

icans: I can find the vertex, axis of symmetry, and y-intercept of a quadratic in standard form and graph it.
I can find the minimum or maximum value and the domain and range.
I can use intercept form to find the x-intercepts and vertex.

vocab: the ___________ line x = h that divides a parabola into mirror images
f(x) = ax² + bx + c; the axis is x = −b/(2a) and the ______________ is c
the _______________ of the vertex when a > 0 / a < 0
f(x) = a(x − p)(x − q); the _______________ are p and q

blocks.p: Plot the points, sketch the parabola, and fold along the line through the lowest point.
Axis of symmetry: __________    Vertex: __________    Which points matched? ________________________

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Standard form: Standard form: the axis of symmetry is x = _______________, and the y-intercept is _______________.

blocks.stem: Graph f(x) = 2x² − 8x + 6. Label the vertex and the axis of symmetry. Give the minimum value and the range.

notes: Minimum or maximum: a > 0: _______________ value; a < 0: _______________ value.

blocks.stem: Find the minimum or maximum value of f(x) = −x² − 6x + 4. Give the domain and range.

notes: Intercept form: Intercept form a(x − p)(x − q): the x-intercepts are _______________.

blocks.stem: Find the x-intercepts, the axis of symmetry, and the vertex of f(x) = −2(x + 3)(x − 1).
